S0642.reason: The Court has abstained under Pullman where a state statute's constitutionality depends on unsettled state law interpretation, as here the statute's validity may turn on state-law construction.

S0122.reason: The friend feigned agreement and lacked genuine intent to further the crime, so no conspiracy; he also did not aid the burglary or larceny.

S0549.reason: Fetal hemoglobin has higher oxygen affinity, so retaining it shifts the dissociation curve left, increasing oxygen binding at tissue PO2 levels.
